description: Direct evidence (a tool-result/tool-error style diagnostic) proves the host SDK's own tool loop already invoked this call. Execution authority already left this package's hands; it must never also report execute for the same call, regardless of how complete or valid its arguments otherwise look.

provenance.note: Models the AI SDK fullStream tool-result/tool-error evidence createAiSdkExecutionGuard() consumes for exactly this purpose - see docs/EXECUTION_GATE.md#execution-ownership-tool-resulttool-error-as-evidence.

events.message: SDK's own tool loop already invoked this call's execute().
